title: VPN access troubleshooting
content: To troubleshoot VPN access, verify your internet connection, ensure your VPN credentials are correct, and multi-factor authentication is approved. If the issue persists, contact support.

title: Admin rights request policy
content: Requests for administrative rights require approval from your manager and IT security. Provide justification and duration. After approval, you may be granted temporary admin rights.

title: Laptop hardware issue: Battery problems
content: If your laptop battery is swollen or not charging, stop using the device immediately and contact hardware support to arrange for a replacement.

title: Shared drive access issue
content: To resolve shared drive access issues, ensure you have the appropriate permissions. If access is denied, submit a request to the storage team to grant access.

title: Password reset and account access
content: If you cannot log in due to a forgotten password, use the password reset tool or contact HR support to reset your account.
